evidence_items.publisher: Sandoval and colleagues; USENIX Security 2023 paper on arXiv

receipt.public_excerpt: We conduct a security-driven user study (N=58) to assess code written by student programmers when assisted by LLMs.

evidence_items.explanation: This study found a small security impact in its C-programming setting and bounded the increase in critical security bugs at 10%. It shows that adverse security findings were not uniform, without ruling out the potential costs Marcus describes.

unresolved_gaps: The cited evidence does not establish the long-term net productivity effect after maintenance and security costs.
